id.description: Dotted identifier, e.g. network.guest.provision. Also the Cedar Action id.

kind.description: read executes under policy alone; write additionally requires a presence-key assertion; elevate enters the break-glass flow.

description.description: Shown to the on-device model and on the confirmation card. Imperative, one sentence.

arguments.description: JSON Schema (2020-12) for the arguments object. The gateway validates before policy. Free-form strings are discouraged; prefer enums and bounded integers.

max_bytes.description: Results are compact by contract. Anything larger is summarized on the LAN before it crosses the overlay.

worker.description: NHI id of the worker that executes this tool.

policy_hints.description: Argument fields Cedar policy may reference as context.args.<name>. Must be a subset of arguments.properties.
